formal_seed_audit: No overlap in 65 existing suite_manifest.json files when registered

methods.B_single: Stage 0 inverse-MSE alpha, one Stage 3 ensemble-target solve; no candidate selector
methods.adaptive: Solve B first; fit B20 ridge on 20 Stage 0 blind labels; trigger Uniform solve only if B fails, is unscorable, or corrected internal target error > 0.01; select the lower internal B20 error, tie to B
methods.new_five_reference: Solve all five pre-existing initial alphas with ensemble-target Stage 3 objective and select using B20 ridge; secondary comparison only

shared_controls: Fixed participant IDs [1,2,20], clean pooled evaluator, 2D target 0, low-quality noise 25 percent, box [-1,1] tolerance 1e-8, best_of 30 custom iterations, no pruning or payment, no Stage 3 cache
information_boundary: Adaptive policy loads pooled evaluator and synthetic truth only after choosing its delivered X. The secondary five-candidate replay loads evaluator earlier and scores candidates before its B20 selection, but its selector accepts only local predictions and Stage 0 labels; pooled/truth scores are not passed to the selector.
primary_quality: Paired absolute pooled error difference adaptive minus B; negative favors adaptive
primary_analysis: Seed-paired bootstrap mean difference, 10000 resamples, fixed research_analysis default RNG, two-sided 95 percent CI; all 180 seeds retained
success_gate: 180/180 B and adaptive valid box-feasible paired deliveries and no higher adaptive failure count
95 percent CI upper bound for mean pooled error difference adaptive minus B strictly below 0
mean adaptive Stage 3 plus selection local-model API requests less than half of the five-candidate reference Stage 3 plus selection requests
cost_scope: API requests and input samples by stage; common training, Stage 0, proposal, and evaluator preparation reported separately; no monetary profitability claim without c/v
secondary_diagnostics: Five-candidate pooled error and query count
p95 and maximum pooled regression versus B
interpretation_limits: One synthetic low-quality scenario only; no tuning or method replacement after seeing formal scores; implementation bug requires new version and affected rerun
amendment_reason: Clarify evaluator load timing of secondary five-candidate replay; no methods, seeds, thresholds, outcomes, or success gates changed.
